answer: A concrete sybil-defense mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. The required words slot into it cleanly: cedar tracks the slashing that punishes duplicate work, reef embodies the random sampling that seats juries, and onyx maps onto the stake an honest agent locks before speaking. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
